items.source: Returns all Revisions of an entity with the given id.
items.translation: 返回给定 ID 实体的所有Revisions。

items.source: Returns the revision of the entity it was last changed in.
items.translation: 返回该实体上次修改时的修订版本。

items.source: Returns the entity with the given ID in the given revision number.
items.translation: 返回给定修订版本中指定 ID 的实体。

items.source: A repository which can access entities held in a variety of Revisions.
items.translation: 一个能够访问各种Revisions中实体的存储库。

items.source: Returns a Page of revisions for the entity with the given id.
items.translation: 返回给定 ID 实体的修订版Page。

items.source: Returns a Page of revisions for the entity with the given id. Note, that it's not guaranteed that implementations have to support sorting by all properties.
items.translation: 返回给定 ID 实体的修订版 Page。请注意，并不保证实现必须支持按所有属性进行排序。

items.source: pageable - the pageable to request a paged result, can be Pageable.unpaged(), must not be null.
items.translation: pageable - 用于请求分页结果的 Pageable 对象，可以是 Pageable.unpaged()，不能为 null。

items.source: the Revision of the entity with the given ID in the given revision number.
items.translation: 给定实体在给定修订号中的Revision。
奥利弗·吉尔克，菲利普·休格尔迈尔
